text:
maya: Quick ask — can we overlay cache-savings and model-sku marginal cost on the per-call heatmap in the cost dashboard? Right now the heatmap only shows raw token burn.

leo: Yep, would help debug bursts and skewed unit-econ. How do we avoid double-counting prefetch credits vs hotpath cache?

sam: I think two layers is clean: gross token burn by default, optional 'net after cache' toggle that subtracts cache credits per-invocation.

anya: UX note: toggles should persist (user + org) and have a clear legend. Also indicate when net < 0 (rare but confusing).

maya: Telemetry implication — we need per-invocation attrs: model_sku, cache_hit boolean, cache_credit_cents, routing_path. Currently sampling drops cache_hit for low-volume routes.

leo: We can try to approximate cache_credit via prefix-match heuristics but that's messy. Better to emit explicit credit.

sam: Proposal: extend invocation proto with two small fields: `cache_credit_cents` and `model_unit_cost_cents`. Small size impact but simplifies downstream joins.

maya: Cost/security note: these are internal cost metrics (sensitive internal accounting) — mark internal-only and strip from any exported telemetry.

ops-bot: telemetry-ingest node: patch queued (build #7182). ETA deploy ~in 3m.

anya: For the heatmap cell UI: show a tiny sparkline, top-1 contributing model, and hover breakdown: gross, cache, quant adj, routing overhead. Hover should also show sample rate and CI for sampled routes.

leo: Also add a 'quota-guardrail' overlay: highlight cells where projected net-cost would have pushed a route over quota in the window. Use 95th percentile projection to avoid noise.

sam: Quick prototype SQL for the hover breakdown (for QA):
```sql
SELECT sum(token_cost_cents) as gross,
       sum(cache_credit_cents) as cache,
       sum(token_cost_cents)-sum(cache_credit_cents) as net
FROM invocations
WHERE ts BETWEEN $start AND $end
GROUP BY model_sku, route
```

maya: Sampling policy: keep global default at 1% for storage reasons, but enforce 100% for routes marked `canary` or `high_sla`. That way UX isn't blind during rollouts.

anya: Rollout UX: before flipping the overlay on orgs, show "estimated billing impact" and let admins opt-in per-org. Also include a confidence band based on sample density.

leo: I'll mock the console panel with the toggle + small preview showing net vs gross delta. Sam: can you handle the telemetry schema PR + backend aggregation change?

sam: Yep. I'll submit schema PR today and queue the Kafka schema bump. Backend ETA end of next sprint, but I can do a small dev-mode demo earlier.

maya: Thanks. @ops-bot ping me when ingest patch is live so I can run a smoke query.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: telemetry-ingest v1.12.3 at 1748500111 :rocket:

maya: Great — I'll open the dashboard PR after schema merges. If no blockers, plan to ship per-org opt-in in the canary wave.
